measurement: Rendered RGB-D orange-color segmentation and calibrated pinhole backprojection
estimator: Random-walk Gaussian object posterior with Mahalanobis innovation gate
odometry: IMU orientation, scalar joint encoders, binary stance contacts and fixed-foot FK anchors
priors: Optional pelvis sphere fiducial local offset and radius
Optional stationary horizontal axis-aligned 20 cm magenta destination marker
limitations: Color-based perception; no semantic visual foundation model
Stance odometry drifts under foot slip and holds during flight
No explicit occlusion-motion model; posterior can become stale
camera_mount: Fixed calibrated job view; no robot or target tracking

color_normalization.detector_encoding: Selected parcel -> orange; selected receiver -> magenta; cyan localization pixels preserved
color_normalization.evidence: Original RGB; delivered RGB-D depth unchanged by color normalization
color_normalization.limitations: Calibrated color classes; no learned semantic instance recognition
